text:
Done on local main: f49bec1b (manifest, generator, README, source-manifest) and 17dd51f0 (cold-review repairs, schema v2). Unpushed.

AC1: docs/data/filmfestival/media-manifest.json lists the 53 files in SHA256SUMS.local by content SHA-256 and size, and gives container, codecs and duration for all 22 videos. Four cand/ files carrying upload-channel suffixes are published as cand/<cover>#n with a path digest. The generator (tools/corpus/filmfest_media_manifest.py, --check) verifies the checksum file line for line.
AC2: trim, clip and scan durations per film by cover name. bus_stop's clip is 406.0 s against a 414.0 s scan, 8.0 s short. The Trillium note's 6 s compares the untrimmed source.
AC3: both excerpts' boundaries per coder as annotation rows and run-relative seconds. catch_me_if_you_can: run 1, content 44-391 s, coarse scenes 4-26. the_prisoner: run 2, 375-636 s, run-relative scenes 32-47 (global 138-153). KM's run-relative numbers are recorded, but its global mapping is unestablished.
AC3 note, because the file is not in Git: the ignored data/filmfestival/FILMS.md was corrected in two steps. (1) the_prisoner is a 260 s mid-episode excerpt (cafe to shop exit), not the opening; 596e70fc -> 800792e5. (2) The claim that catch_me_if_you_can is the feature's opening 346 s is now marked as reported, not verified locally; 800792e5 -> 741150d3. Both steps are recorded in source-manifest.json under revisions. The original is kept at the session scratchpad FILMS.md.orig.
AC4: the Trillium roots are recorded. The per-directory mapping is inferred from provenance scripts; Trillium itself was not read.
AC5: git check-ignore holds. No media, frames, transcripts, URLs or titles are committed; 0 grep hits in the manifest and generator.
AC6: admissionStatus.state is still proposed, and the README says the media are staged locally.

Gate: a fresh-context cold review of f49bec1b re-hashed all 53 files, re-probed all 22 videos and re-derived the excerpt rows, with no numeric discrepancy. It found four fixable defects (four cand/ names, KM nulls meaning two things, hosting names in code, a FILMS.md contradiction) plus overclaims. All were repaired in 17dd51f0, and the committer re-verified them: 53/53 rows, 4 redacted by path digest, byte-identical regeneration, --check 0.
Reviewer finding not claimed in the manifest: a frame-PSNR probe peaked at the recorded trim for bus_stop, post_it_love, the_record and keith_reynolds, and one source frame early for the_shoe. Trim verification remains a non-claim there.
Not established: the repairs have not had an independent second review; the clip edition is not proven equivalent to the presented edition; the annotation-to-events clock offset is unresolved.
